about_the_game:
Hold your lighter close, it's dark out there.

You take the role as Seph, an artistically inclined child who embarks on a sprawling journey across their unusual world- all just to get food for their dog.

Explore the topsy-turvy lands of this world as make some new friends, meet peculiar citizens, fight off nightmarish creatures, and uncover dark and unsettling truths.

Demo Features:

  • 2D RPG gameplay with minor platforming elements

  • Getting to know the uncomfortable world you inhabit

  • A unique enemy to encounter to show you what's to come

  • A progression system based around Seph's art

  • A colorful cast of peculiar characters scattered throughout the world

  • Yes, you can pet the dog
